method: No hallucinations: every Dataset A listing was re-opened on its official product source and compared field by field. Official seller policy pages, Trustpilot snapshots and four gold-price publishers were read separately. A value absent from the source stays null; conflicting source statements stay flagged; no price, weight, carat, purity, stone inclusion or availability is inferred.
scope: All 19 Dataset A products; all 5 Dataset A retailer policy and Trustpilot records; Ross-Simons BND-04 plus approximate-weight labels on BND-04–BND-07; four spot-reference publishers. Datasets B/C outside those named rows retain their prior dated checks.
source_channel_note: The unqualified Aurate 2ct-round HTML URL returned an official 404 to the text fetch. The direct official variant HTML, official Shopify .js endpoint and official engagement collection all support $2,858, so the exact variant URL is used. Indexed search snippets showing other prices were not used as evidence.
